item.title: New roadside wall (between road and cycling lane) presents a serious safety hazard due to inadequate warning/visibility, 22nd September
item.description:
A new short wall has been constructed following recent road works - it seperates the road from the cycling lane for about a metre or two. Unlike the other similar roadside walls in the area, this wall has no warning sign, reflective marking or other clear visibility measures. The wall is difficult to see when approaching and presents a potential collision/accident hazard, particularly at night or in poor visibility. As this is a newly constructed feature, the council should urgently assess whether appropriate warning signage, markings or other safety measures are required.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Clerkenwell Road, Holborn, Greater London
